scope: Feature SESSION-INTEGRATION, change IDLE-001: fix Codex passive terminal reports invalidating fresh eligible idle state. Preserve real input/navigation cancellation, budgets, queue ownership and byte forwarding. Prepare distinct unreleased 0.2.3 binary for repair; no personal installation or live-process changes.

acceptance.description: Keep input threshold strictly above 100000, Codex idle20min, four-hour real-user budget, current-turn freshness, busy/compaction/disconnect and pre-dispatch cancellation rules.
Native parser errors and permission precedence remain unchanged; unsupported forms pass through.
Setup remains an install alias with owned provider discovery and opt-in warming.
Owned repair restores standalone and source integrations without adopting available unowned providers.
Repair preserves warming preferences/custom settings; explicit --warm only enables selected warming options.
Repair reports effective readiness/restart requirements without bypassing native trust/global disables.
Same/newer update catchup and operation lock ordering remain verified.
Ownership/path conflicts fail before writes; late provider failure compensates prior integration and activation.
Distinct synchronized 0.2.3 binary embeds exact runtime/native assets and works after build checkout removal.

Recognized passive focus notifications and terminal protocol responses, including fragmented and coalesced sequences, preserve completed-turn metrics, real activity timestamp and idle eligibility. Pending protocol bytes block dispatch until classification; malformed/unknown/expired sequences fail closed.

Actual keyboard input, escape/navigation, mouse actions and bracketed paste still invalidate composition/old eligibility and cancel pre-dispatch warming. Mixed protocol and real input cannot swallow real activity; raw native input bytes and UTF-8 text are preserved.
Native local owner preserves exact model/cwd/permission arguments without remote overrides or CODEX_HOME overlay.

Real source and packaged timed marker/K delivery occurs through the exact live owner queue with nonce continuity after passive terminal events, never by typing marker keys or second conversation writer.
CLI and in-session resume retain native identity/cwd and require fresh completed reply, while passive reports do not masquerade as navigation.
Standalone 0.2.3 embeds the decoder and native assets, has synchronized distinct version identity, supports repair migration and actual packaged native warming.
Repair preserves owned provider settings/native executable/paths/trust boundaries and requires honest relaunch/readiness. No personal installation or publication.
Conflicting/unknown owners, observer errors and untrusted hooks skip warming; owned subprocess cleanup and exact queue attribution remain verified.
Repeatable E2E retains raw native hook/queue/rollout/terminal evidence with personal hashes unchanged and explicit probe timing. No post-code unit tests.
